## Description

Combines Fourier Neural Operators with multivariate Hawkes point processes incorporating delay differential memory terms to model continuous order arrival intensities and price jumps under transmission lags.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency limit order book forecasting under policy announcement delays, fragmented venue liquidity transmission.

## Vehicles

High-Frequency Trading Firms, Statistical Arbitrage Prop Desks.

## Required data

Millisecond limit order book level 2/3 message feeds, trade timestamps, policy announcement schedules.

## Caveats

Requires GPU acceleration for neural operator mesh discretization and Hawkes kernel updates.
